title: ggsegCraddock: Craddock Functional Parcellations for the 'ggseg' Ecosystem — ggsegCraddock-package
text: Craddock spatially constrained spectral clustering brain parcellations 'ggsegverse' ecosystem. Includes CC200 CC400 parcellations Craddock 2012 ADHD-200 datasets. various resolutions 'ggseg' ecosystem. Provides unified 'ggseg_atlas' object 2D polygon geometry 3D vertex indices, use 'ggseg' 'ggseg3d'.

title: ggsegCraddock 1.0.3
text: Atlas 2D geometry migrated sf-optional brain_polygons format (ggseg.formats 0.0.3). atlases now render without sf GDAL/GEOS/PROJ system libraries, enabling wasm air-gapped installs. Plots unchanged.
